llms.body:
# TokensHubs

> OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible LLM API. One Base URL reaches multiple models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, MiniMax, Tencent and Xiaomi, with credit-based billing (1 credit = 1/1,000,000 USD), a published price table, and per-request cost verification in every response.

TokensHubs is a relay platform: bring your own API key in the console, call any supported model through three wire-compatible protocols, and pay only for the tokens you use. Recharge via USDT (TRC20), WeChat/Alipay channels, or gift codes. Partners can resell access with tier-based bonuses and referral rebates. A daily transparency report publishes reserve coverage and expired-credit disclosure.

## Documentation

- [API documentation](https://tokenshubs.com/docs): Base URL, authentication, models and pricing, rate limits, error codes
- [Rules for automated clients](https://tokenshubs.com/agents.md): what an agent may rely on, access rules, what is not offered
- [OpenAPI contract](https://tokenshubs.com/.well-known/openapi.json): read-only OpenAPI 3.1 document for the public endpoints
- [Transparency report](https://tokenshubs.com/transparency): daily merkle snapshots, reserve coverage, expired credits
- [Console](https://tokenshubs.com/login): API keys, usage and balance, orders, recharge

## API

- Base URL: `https://tokenshubs.com/v1`
- Chat completions: `POST /v1/chat/completions` (OpenAI SDK compatible)
- Responses: `POST /v1/responses` (OpenAI SDK compatible)
- Messages: `POST /v1/messages` (Anthropic SDK compatible)
- Models: `GET /v1/models`
- Authentication: `Authorization: Bearer <api-key>`

## Conventions

- Every relay response carries `x-th-request-id` and `x-th-charged` so you can verify exactly what was billed. Streaming responses report `x-th-charged: pending` until the usage log settles.
- Errors use structured JSON: `{"error": {"code": "TH-...", "message": "..."}}` with documented codes on the docs page.
- Streaming (SSE) is supported on all chat endpoints.

## Not offered

- No MCP server is published; `/.well-known/mcp` returns a real 404. No OAuth/agent-authorization surface exists beyond API keys and session login.
- No public write API: an agent cannot create accounts, move credits or administer the service.
- No SLA or uptime guarantee is claimed.

## Agent usage policy

- Read-only polling is welcome: `GET /health`, `GET /v1/models`, `GET /v1/balance` and every public page above. Rate limits still apply (HTTP 429 `TH-RATE-LIMITED`).
- Authenticated relay calls (`POST /v1/chat/completions`, `/v1/responses`, `/v1/messages`) cost credits and are never free: each accepted request is charged.
- Credentials: send API keys only in the `Authorization: Bearer` header. Never place keys, session cookies or personal data in a crawler-visible URL.
- Caching: `llms.txt`, `llms-full.txt`, `agents.md` and `/.well-known/openapi.json` are stable documents; treat `lastmod` in `/sitemap.xml` as the freshness signal.
- Contact for crawler or access questions: https://github.com/TokensHubs/tokenshubs/issues

llmsFull.body:
# TokensHubs — full site description for LLM agents

TokensHubs (https://tokenshubs.com) is an OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible LLM API relay with credit-based billing. This file is the machine-readable summary; the human documentation lives at https://tokenshubs.com/docs and the transparency report at https://tokenshubs.com/transparency.

## What it is

- One Base URL (`https://tokenshubs.com/v1`) for multiple LLM providers: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, MiniMax, Tencent, Xiaomi (14 models at time of writing; the live list is `GET /v1/models`).
- Pay-as-you-go credits: 1 credit = 1/1,000,000 USD. Prices per model (input/output/cache-read/cache-write) are published on the docs page and applied per token actually used.
- Bring-your-own-key console: create API keys, watch usage and balance, top up, and read a per-request billing trail.

## Protocols

| Endpoint | Protocol | Compatibility |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `POST /v1/chat/completions` | OpenAI chat completions (SSE streaming) | OpenAI SDK, drop-in `base_url` |
| `POST /v1/responses` | OpenAI responses | OpenAI SDK |
| `POST /v1/messages` | Anthropic messages | Anthropic SDK |
| `GET /v1/models` | Model catalog, active/priced only | OpenAI SDK |

Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <api-key>` on every request.

## Billing and verification

- Every response includes `x-th-request-id` (trace id) and `x-th-charged` (credits deducted; streaming responses report `pending` with the exact value available in the console usage log).
- Insufficient balance returns HTTP 402 `TH-INSUFFICIENT` before any upstream work happens; rate limits return HTTP 429 `TH-RATE-LIMITED`.
- Error body shape: `{"error": {"code": "TH-...", "message": "...", "detail": {...}}}`. Full code table: https://tokenshubs.com/docs

## Recharge

- USDT (TRC20), WeChat/Alipay aggregate channels, and one-time gift codes.
- Gift codes are shown once at creation; only a hash is stored afterwards.
- Packages add a bonus on top of face value; bonus credits expire after 30 days and are disclosed as such.

## Trust and transparency

- Daily transparency report: merkle snapshot of the ledger, reserve coverage ratio, expired-credit disclosure — https://tokenshubs.com/transparency
- The service states no SLA it does not publish; check the docs page for rate limits and supported features.

## For agents

- Site pages for humans: `/` (product), `/docs` (API reference), `/transparency` (reports), `/login` / `/register` (console).
- This file: `/llms.txt`; extended version: `/llms-full.txt`; crawler policy: `/robots.txt`; sitemap: `/sitemap.xml`.
- Rules for automated clients: `/agents.md`; OpenAPI 3.1 contract: `/.well-known/openapi.json`.
- The console and partner/admin areas require login and are not crawlable.
- No MCP server is published: `/.well-known/mcp` returns a real 404, not a page. No public write API exists for accounts, credits or administration, and no SLA is claimed.

homepage.body:
Documentation Transparency Pricing FAQ Agents Log in Create account

One hub for every model, billed in credits

TokensHubs gives you OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible access through a single endpoint. Published prices, instant top-ups, and an itemized charge you can verify on every request.

What TokensHubs is

TokensHubs is an LLM API relay: one Base URL in front of several providers, so an SDK written for OpenAI or Anthropic keeps working while you switch models. You create an API key in the console, point your client at https://tokenshubs.com/v1, and call any model that is listed by GET /v1/models. There is no subscription tier: credits are consumed by the tokens you actually use, and every response reports what it cost.

Protocols

Three wire-compatible surfaces are served from the same key:

  • POST /v1/chat/completions — OpenAI chat completions, with SSE streaming.
  • POST /v1/responses — the OpenAI responses API.
  • POST /v1/messages — the Anthropic messages API.
  • GET /v1/models and GET /v1/balance — catalog and balance.

Authentication is Authorization: Bearer <api-key>. Errors are structured JSON: {"error": {"code": "TH-...", "message": "..."}}. The full code table lives on the documentation page, and a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 contract is published for the public endpoints.

How billing works

One credit has a face value of 1/1,000,000 USD. You top up in dollars, receive face-value credits plus any tier bonus, and every request deducts credits for the tokens you actually use — itemized per call. The per-token price table is published, identical for every account, and visible in the console before you spend anything. Each response carries x-th-request-id and x-th-charged so a charge can be reconciled against your own logs; streaming responses report pending and settle into the usage log.

Recharge channels are USDT (TRC20) with zero fee and a unique amount per order, WeChat Pay and Alipay through the fiat gateway, and gift codes redeemed from the recharge page. Insufficient balance returns HTTP 402 TH-INSUFFICIENT before any upstream work is attempted; per-key rate limits return HTTP 429 TH-RATE-LIMITED.

Transparency

A daily transparency report publishes a merkle snapshot of the ledger, the reserve coverage ratio and expired-credit disclosure, so the published balance can be checked against the recorded one. Bonus credits expire after 30 days by default, referral credits after 180 days, and paid credits are valid for 10 years.

FAQ

What exactly is a credit?

One credit has a face value of 1/1,000,000 USD. You top up in dollars, receive face-value credits plus any tier bonus, and every request deducts credits for the tokens you actually use — itemized per call.

Are the prices the same for everyone?

Yes — one published price list applies to every account and every key. What you see in the table is what you pay, with no per-account adjustments.

Do bonus credits expire?

Yes — bonus credits expire after 30 days by default, referral credits after 180 days, and paid credits are valid for 10 years. Expired remainders are disclosed daily on the transparency page.

Which payment channels are supported?

USDT (TRC20) with zero fee and a unique amount per order, WeChat Pay and Alipay through the fiat gateway, plus gift cards redeemed from the recharge page.

For automated clients

Agents and crawlers should read agents.md for what may be relied on, and llms.txt for a machine-readable map of the site. No MCP server is published: /.well-known/mcp returns a real 404. There is no public write API for accounts, credits or administration.

Contact and issues: github.com/TokensHubs/tokenshubs/issues. Site copy last reviewed 2026-11-17.

© 2026 TokensHubs

agentsMd.body:
# TokensHubs — rules for automated clients

TokensHubs (https://tokenshubs.com) is an OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible LLM API relay. This file
states what an automated client or agent may rely on. It is deliberately limited to behaviour that is
implemented and observable in production.

## Machine-readable entry points

- Site summary: https://tokenshubs.com/llms.txt
- Extended summary: https://tokenshubs.com/llms-full.txt
- API contract (OpenAPI 3.1, read-only): https://tokenshubs.com/.well-known/openapi.json
- Crawler policy: https://tokenshubs.com/robots.txt
- Sitemap: https://tokenshubs.com/sitemap.xml

## Access rules

- Public, unauthenticated: the marketing site (`/`), documentation (`/docs`), transparency report
  (`/transparency`), `robots.txt`, `sitemap.xml`, `llms.txt`, `llms-full.txt`, `agents.md`,
  `/.well-known/openapi.json`, and `GET /health`.
- Authenticated: everything under `/v1/` requires `Authorization: Bearer <api-key>`. Console pages
  (`/dashboard`, `/keys`, `/orders`, `/recharge`), partner pages (`/partner/*`) and administration
  pages (`/admin/*`) require a signed-in session cookie and are not intended for crawling.
- There is no public write API for credits, accounts or administration. Any claim that an automated
  agent can create accounts, change balances or administer the service is incorrect.

## Read-only guarantees

- `GET /health`, `GET /v1/models`, `GET /v1/balance` and every documented page above are safe to
  poll; they do not mutate state. Rate limits still apply (HTTP 429 `TH-RATE-LIMITED`).
- Model calls (`POST /v1/chat/completions`, `POST /v1/responses`, `POST /v1/messages`) cost credits
  and are never idempotent in a billing sense: each accepted request is charged.

## Errors

All JSON errors share one shape:

```json
{"error": {"code": "TH-...", "message": "...", "detail": {}}}
```

`detail` is optional. The full code table is published at https://tokenshubs.com/docs.

## What is not offered

- No MCP server is published. Requests under `/.well-known/mcp` return a real 404; a 200 must not be
  assumed. No OAuth/agent-authorization surface is documented beyond API keys and session login.
- No published SLA, uptime guarantee or certification is claimed anywhere on the site.
- No training-data licence is granted by `robots.txt`; crawling allowances describe indexing only.

## Contact

Operational issues: open an issue in the public repository or use the contact channel listed on the
site. Never place API keys, session cookies or personal data in crawler-visible URLs.
